def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    bars=sorted(r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c]!=0 and ((c>0 and g[r][c-1]==g[r][c]) or (c<w-1 and g[r][c+1]==g[r][c])) for c in range(w)))
    def bar_color(b,s):
        if g[b][s]!=0: return g[b][s]
        if s>0 and g[b][s-1]!=0: return g[b][s-1]
        if s<w-1 and g[b][s+1]!=0: return g[b][s+1]
        return None
    for s in range(w):
        r=0
        while r<h:
            if g[r][s]!=0 and (r==0 or g[r-1][s]!=g[r][s]):
                e=r
                while e+1<h and g[e+1][s]==g[r][s]: e+=1
                col=g[r][s]
                in_bar=any((s>0 and g[rr][s-1]==col) or (s<w-1 and g[rr][s+1]==col) for rr in range(r,e+1))
                if not in_bar:
                    above=[b for b in bars if b<r]
                    below=[b for b in bars if b>e]
                    if above and (not below or r-above[-1] <= below[0]-e):
                        for rr in range(above[-1]+1,h): out[rr][s]=col
                        cur=col
                        for i in range(len(above)-1,-1,-1):
                            b=above[i]
                            bc=bar_color(b,s)
                            if bc is not None: cur=bc
                            lo=0 if i==0 else above[i-1]+1
                            for rr in range(lo,b+1): out[rr][s]=cur

                            for rr in range(b,hi+1): out[rr][s]=cur
                r=e+1
            else: r+=1
